name: welded pipe path draws itself from a spark
looks: A bright weld-spark point sits alone in the dark, throwing off a cone of orange sparks. From it, a thick metal pipe draws itself outward segment by segment, turning once at a right angle, with a dimension line and length label ticking in beneath it. A headline burns in over the top, then swaps to a second line in the accent colour.
build: 2D canvas path drawn progressively (strokeDashoffset or a point-by-point reveal) with a rounded, lit stroke; a particle emitter (15-20 sparks, random velocity, gravity, fade) rides the leading tip. The dimension line and length text key in just behind the draw. Headline swap is a hard cross-cut with no easing.
sound: A faint weld sizzle under the draw, a soft tick as the dimension label locks in.
prompt: Open on a single bright spark in the dark, throwing off particles. From that point, draw a rigid structural line segment by segment, turning once at an angle, with a measurement readout ticking in beside it as it grows. Hold a short headline over the top, then hard-cut it to a second, bolder line in the accent colour.
